lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters organized in 4-5 distinct horizontal rows on the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient (light superiorly, dark inferiorly).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 10 high-intensity circular spots distributed within the boundary of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, low-luminance clusters (remoras) located ventral to the abdominal region.
